title: 4 CHECKS
BEFORE YOU
*POST*
subtitle: Run these on every reel before you hit post.
tagline: From the reel: don't post until it passes all four.

blocks.heading: How to *use* this
blocks.intro: Watch your finished cut once per check. Each check takes about ten seconds, and each one is something an AI reel analyzer scores before you post.
steps: Watch it on your phone, the way your audience will.
Hook, pacing, audio, ending. Fix anything that fails before moving on.
One fixed problem beats four half-fixed ones.
Upload the cut to Creedom's Reel Analyzer for a score on each check, second by second.
blocks.note: Tip: check number 4, the ending, is the one almost nobody checks.

items.line: Watch your first frame with the sound off. Can a stranger tell what this reel is about in [1 second]?
items.example: A talking head with no text on screen. Fix: add a short title on the first frame, like "3 meals under 100".
items.why: Many people scroll with the sound off, so the first frame has to make sense on its own.

items.line: Scrub through it. Does something change every [2 seconds]: a cut, a zoom, new text or a new angle?
items.example: One 8-second shot. Fix: cut it into four shots, or add a text pop every two seconds.
items.why: A frame that never changes gives the thumb a reason to keep scrolling.

items.line: Play it on your phone speaker at [half volume]. Is every word clear over the music?
items.example: Music as loud as your voice. Fix: turn the music down well under your voice, or drop it while you talk.
items.why: If people can't hear the point, they won't wait for it.

items.line: Does the last second give people a reason to [rewatch], [comment] or [save]?
items.example: It just stops. Fix: end on a question, loop back to the first frame, or say "save this for your next post".
items.why: A reel that just stops gives people nothing to do next.

blocks.heading: Before you *post*
items: Hook: the first frame makes sense on mute
Audio: every word is clear over the music
Ending: there's a reason to rewatch, comment or save
Optional: score it in Creedom's Reel Analyzer
